_sheet: Hooks into PEAK. One row = one place the mod attaches to the game. Harmony rows generate a patch class in Generated/HarmonyHooks.cs whose Prefix/Postfix forward to CampfireCards.Hooks.<handler>Prefix / CampfireCards.Hooks.<handler>; event and unity rows are subscribed by hand in Hooks.Subscribe() (preflight checks the member name appears there).

_columns.signature: comma-separated parameter types of the target for overload resolution; empty = unique
_columns.prefixArgs: verbatim C# parameter list of the generated Prefix (empty = no prefix)
_columns.prefixBool: true = the Prefix returns bool (false skips the original)
_columns.postfixArgs: verbatim C# parameter list of the generated Postfix (empty = no postfix); '-' = none
_columns.handler: base name of the static methods in CampfireCards.Hooks
_columns.verified: how it was confirmed against the decompiled game
_columns.finalizerArgs: Optional exception-safe cleanup; calls handler + Finalizer and returns the original exception.
